Published lost/stolen-card action (DOs & DON'Ts of ATM cum Debit Card, item 15): immediately inform the Bank; if the card is held by an ATM, inform the Bank Branch as well as the Helpline 18003095790, and email customerservices.card@wbstcb.com and cardpayment@wbstcb.com plus the respective home branch at bm.branchname@wbstcb.com; the contact page separately publishes cardpayment@wbstcb.bank.in under 'for ATM/ Debit Card'. No SMS block keyword/short code, no in-app block menu and no netbanking card-block option are published on any checked official page: WBSCB Mobile Banking exists ('download latest version ... from Google Play Store only' per the mobile-banking privacy policy, but no store URL is published on the site) and the internet-banking portal inb.wbstcb.bank.in/OnlineWBSCB/ offers Retail/Corporate logins, yet neither page documents a card-blocking self-service path, so the published channels are the helpline, the card emails and the home branch. The bank's own pages do not mention the 1930 cybercrime helpline. No winding-up, liquidation or licence-cancellation notice appears on the site; the bank is publishing current notices and audited annual accounts 2025-26.
